testRecord.environment: SAP BTP AppRouter + XSUAA + SAP HANA Cloud

expectedResult: Input beyond the supported 1000-character limit is rejected safely and no truncated or partial comment is stored.
actualResult: On the current UI-only runtime, the PM entered an exact 1000-character controlled marker, posted it successfully, and saw it after reload. The one allowed exact 1001-character marker was retained in the TextArea, rejected by CAP with HTTP 400, showed a safe UI Error dialog, and was absent after reload with no truncated or partial comment stored.
reviewBoundary: Final PASS approved under the parent-authorized user decision; no Jira approval or Jira mutation is claimed.

oneThousand.reloadResult: The marker is visibly present once in Comments after reload.

oneThousandOne.uiResult: Safe generic Error dialog: The comment could not be posted. Please refresh and try again.

evidence.description: Current PM runtime after reload: Comments visibly shows the single UAT-COM-003-1000 marker.
Current PM runtime: safe Error dialog is visible while the full controlled UAT-COM-003-1001 input remains in the TextArea; no unrelated sensitive data is shown.

historicalFailure.actualResult: A 1006-character controlled comment was accepted with Comment posted and remained listed after reload instead of being rejected. The UI collapsed it behind MORE, so the boundary contract was violated.
historicalFailure.reviewBoundary: Historical pre-fix runtime failure retained for traceability; it is not overwritten by the current candidate result.

evidence.description: Historical oversized controlled comment accepted by the pre-fix UI.
Historical oversized comment remained listed after reload.

privacyReview.notes: The controlled PM Bug route and screenshots contain only the Bug number, controlled marker text, actor display name/role, and safe UI state; no credential, token, email, or unrelated private data was used.

issueClassification: historical deployed-runtime boundary failure resolved in current UI runtime; final PASS evidence meets expected result
limitations: The safe UI message is generic; the browser console/network evidence exposes the exact CAP reason and HTTP 400.

The rejection screenshot visibly shows the retained controlled input, while the exact 1001-character length and no-persistence result are recorded from the PM TextArea accessibility readback and post-reload Comments readback.
